title: Paloma and the Machine
author: Lior Crane
blurb: Astrid Almeida, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
